title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Fruit Gum Prefilled Vape Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Fruit Gum delivers a bright and juicy mix of fruity confectionery flavour. Inspired by chewy fruit confectionery, this blend combines a rainbow of tropical and berry notes with a sweet, sugary-like finish for a vape that’s smooth, vibrant and packed with flavour. Each pack features a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container designed for the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit, delivering up to 6000 puffs (based on personal usage) of smooth, consistent vapour. Dual mesh coil technology brings out every layer of flavour, while the auto-refill mechanism and leak-resistant design ensure ease of use and minimal fuss. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod delivers a fast-acting nicotine hit and a tactile yet comfortable throat feel ideal for MTL vaping. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to keep enjoying this sweet, nostalgic fruit blend.
